page-organizations-experts-description: There are several organisations that can help you decide if Ethereum is the right choice for your organisation:
page-organizations-experts-eea-descripti: The EEA is a member-based organization and the official channel showcasing Ethereum as the leading ecosystem for enterprise adoption. This is where enterprises, institutions, and Ethereum leaders coordinate what comes next.
page-organizations-experts-etherealize-d: Etherealize is building the rails to move Wall Street onto Ethereum, bringing the financial system into the 21st century.
page-organizations-experts-ethereum-inst: An independent non-profit dedicated to accelerating the institutional adoption of Ethereum, its L2s, applications and overall ecosystem.
page-organizations-experts-ethsystems-de: EthSystems helps institutions move on-chain with privacy that's performant, secure, usable, and accessible, disclosing only what the rules require.
page-organizations-further-reading-enter: See how organizations use Ethereum for open digital infrastructure.
See how L2s give organizations a tailored environment while settling on Ethereum.
page-organizations-further-reading-oncha: See how stablecoins, payments, and capital markets work on Ethereum's programmable financial rails.
page-organizations-further-reading-priva: Learn how institutions can balance compliance with privacy.
page-organizations-further-reading-token: Understand how assets can be issued, managed, and exchanged more efficiently on Ethereum.
page-organizations-hub-adoption-descript: The opportunity for organisations is increasingly about payments, commerce and financial infrastructure rather than speculation.
page-organizations-hub-adoption-title: Global crypto adoption is on the rise
page-organizations-hub-audiences-descrip: Production-grade, open settlement network for tokenized assets, stablecoins, and financial infrastructure.
page-organizations-hub-audiences-enterpr: Evaluate Ethereum for digital assets, financial operations, and shared business infrastructure.
page-organizations-hub-audiences-founder: Build products on open infrastructure with shared standards and a global ecosystem of users and developers.
page-organizations-hub-audiences-public-: Explore how Ethereum can support public services, transparent funding, and social impact.
page-organizations-hub-audiences-small-b: Use Ethereum tools to accept digital payments and transact with customers and suppliers globally.
page-organizations-hub-faq-1-answer: Ethereum provides shared infrastructure that does not depend on a single company or consortium. Organizations can still apply their own permissions, privacy, and operational controls at higher layers.
page-organizations-hub-faq-1-question: Why use Ethereum instead of a private blockchain?
page-organizations-hub-faq-2-answer: Yes. Sensitive information can remain outside the public chain while Ethereum provides settlement, proofs, or audit references. Privacy technologies can also verify information without revealing the underlying data.
page-organizations-hub-faq-2-question: Can organizations keep sensitive data private?
page-organizations-hub-faq-3-answer: Yes. Institutions can connect through regulated intermediaries, custody providers, L2 networks, and hybrid systems while retaining compliance and operational controls.
page-organizations-hub-faq-3-question: Does Ethereum work with existing financial infrastructure?
page-organizations-hub-faq-4-answer: Current uses include tokenized funds and bonds, stablecoin settlement, digital identity, public records, grant distribution, and specialized institutional networks.
page-organizations-hub-faq-4-question: How are organizations using Ethereum today?

page-organizations-hub-meta-description: Learn how businesses, governments, nonprofits and startups are using Ethereum as shared, neutral digital infrastructure for payments, tokenized assets, identity and records.

page-organizations-hub-what-custom-descr: Build L2 or hybrid systems with tailored privacy, access, and performance while using Ethereum for settlement and verification.
page-organizations-hub-what-description: Explore practical ways organizations are using Ethereum today, from payments and tokenized assets to identity and digital infrastructure.
page-organizations-hub-what-identity-des: Verify credentials and anchor important records without exposing more information than necessary.
page-organizations-hub-what-payments-des: Move value globally, automate treasury flows, and settle using digital currencies.
page-organizations-hub-what-title: What can organizations do with Ethereum?
page-organizations-hub-what-tokenized-de: Issue and manage funds, bonds, deposits, or other assets with programmable ownership and rules.
page-organizations-hub-why-description: Ethereum provides a shared base layer for transactions and digital agreements without requiring organizations to trust a single operator. Applications can add their own privacy, compliance and access controls while using Ethereum for settlement and verification.
page-organizations-hub-why-interoperable: Open standards let assets and applications work across wallets, platforms, and compatible networks.
page-organizations-hub-why-neutral-descr: No company, government, or consortium controls access to the network.
page-organizations-hub-why-programmable-: Smart contracts automate rules while transactions and proofs can be independently verified.
page-organizations-hub-why-resilient-des: Independent operators around the world keep Ethereum running without a single point of failure.
